answer: Work waits on the glacier until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the tundra of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vertex of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
